tools.name: get_flight_stats
tools.description: Get Iași Airport punctuality and cancellation statistics — share of flights delayed ≥15 min and cancelled counts, for today, yesterday, and the rolling 7- and 30-day windows. Pass `window` to focus the summary on one period (all windows are always returned in data).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_museums · Public sink: get_flight_stats, find_daily_menus.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_museums · Public sink: get_flight_stats, find_daily_menus

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_flights" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
